vsl_script.text:
FLEET VSL. Target length 3 to 6 minutes. Adon or CC on camera, landscape, eye level, quiet room. Oasis Studio adds captions, b-roll, the screen recordings named below and the OASIS end card.
Rule for the whole video: say no number, result or client story that is not on the page. Prices are said exactly as the page shows them. The audit report shown on screen is synthetic: headings and structure only, never a real company's findings.

[BEAT 1. HOOK, 0:00 to 0:20]
On camera: Every vendor in your inbox says AI will fix it. Nobody has looked at how your operation actually runs, location by location.

[BEAT 2. WHO THIS IS FOR, AND WHO IT IS NOT FOR]
On camera: This is for mid-market and multi-location operations. It is not for a one-person business. PROTOCOL or COMMAND fit that better. And if you are not ready for any of it, the free community is linked below this video.

[BEAT 3. WHY IT KEEPS HAPPENING]
On camera: AI projects stall because they start with a tool, not an audit. A pilot works for one team, adds data risk nobody owns, and never becomes how the business runs.

[BEAT 4. WHAT WE DO ABOUT IT]
On camera: Before anyone builds anything, we audit where AI pays back and where it is a liability.
Screen recording: the shape of the audit report, headings only.
Voice over: Three steps. You request the audit. We run it and hand you a statement of work and a roadmap. If you go ahead, we build the fleet, and the audit fee is credited in full.

[BEAT 5. WHAT YOU GET, PRICES SAID OUT LOUD]
On camera, matching the page word for word:
The enterprise AI and security audit, $2,500 to $7,500, credited in full to the build.
Bespoke multi-agent fleets, $5,000 to $15,000 and up.
A website rebuild, $2,000 to $5,000, or start with a $500 website audit.
Note for the recording: once Adon picks one number for each range, say that number, and update this script and the page together.

[BEAT 6. PROOF]
No permissioned examples are confirmed yet, so show the audit report's structure instead and walk through what each part answers.

[BEAT 7. CALL TO ACTION]
On camera: Request your audit below. Not ready? The free community is linked right below this video.
